title: Domain exceptions
scope: Exception hierarchy used by services + mapped to HTTP by T-008. DomainError (base, → 500), NotFoundError(entity, id_) (→ 404), ConflictError(message) (→ 409), ValidationError(message) (→ 422).

success_criteria.manual: `python -c 'from src.domain.exceptions import DomainError, NotFoundError, ConflictError, ValidationError; raise NotFoundError("Foo", 1)'` raises with message including 'Foo' and '1'.
success_criteria.automated: Indirectly tested via service tests (TC-017 ConflictError, TC-027/028 NotFoundError, TC-002/003/009/013/021 Pydantic ValidationError NOT domain ValidationError).
success_criteria.definition_of_done: Four classes export; NotFoundError constructor takes (entity, id_); ConflictError + ValidationError take (message).

checkout_prompt: On completion: 'Domain exceptions created — DomainError, NotFoundError, ConflictError, ValidationError. Mapped to HTTP by T-008.'
